name: advance-app
description: Use AdvanceAppFlow to start, adopt, continue, and improve Advance applications one prompt at a time under programmer control.

interface.shortDescription: Develop Advance apps one prompt at a time.
interface.longDescription: AdvanceAppFlow creates or adopts an application, executes one prompt, reports result and remaining work, learns from systemic application corrections, and waits for the programmer before advancing or rerunning.
defaultPrompt: Use $advance-app-start to create a new Advance application.
Use $advance-app-continue to continue or correct an Advance project.
Continue the Advance lifecycle from an existing project path.
